config.advertiser_summary: Professional-quality cookware and knives sold direct-to-consumer, used in restaurants and targeted at serious home cooks, primarily male.

assumptions: Margin not given; assumed 55% (typical for home) for the break-even estimate only.
Break-even per customer (guidance, not enforced): $100 x 55% x 1.1 orders = $60.50.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click: verifiable without trusting a pixel. Maximise conversions within the budget: bids move between $0.25 and the $2.50 cap (category default) to spend it well; no CPA target is invented. Guidance: at the assumed margin, a click is worth about $0.73; bidding above that loses money per customer. Set a target CPA or a lower max CPC to enforce it.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.
